line: I couldn't put an answer together for that, sorry. Please ask me again.
rejected: Something went wrong on my side and I couldn't finish that, so please don't count on it being done.
unreachable: Sorry, I've lost my train of thought for a moment. I'm still on it and will answer here.
act: Your last reply only said you were about to act, and no tool was called. Do not say it again: this time call the tool that does the work now, and answer once it has run.
hand_off: This work is taking many steps. If what is left is a build or a long loop with a clear brief, hand it to a worker now with bench_hand_off, naming the pieces it needs, and tell the person it is underway. Otherwise carry on.
wrap_up: You have no more tools this turn. Tell the person where the work stands for them: what is done, and what you could not do or still need from them.
too_big: Your last attempt was too long for one reply and was cut off, so nothing came of it. Do not try it all at once: make the smallest real change that moves the work forward with a tool now, and run it, or say plainly what you need.
too_big_hand_off: Your last attempt was too long for one reply and was cut off, so nothing came of it. Work this big is not for one reply: hand it to a worker now with bench_hand_off, with a clear brief and the pieces it needs, and tell the person it is underway.
too_big_line: That was too big for me to do in one go, so nothing came of it. Ask me for a smaller part of it.
stand: You can do no more on this now. Tell the person where it stands: what is done, what is not, and what they can ask you to do next. Never say you will do more.
